newsitem.title: ITALY: Ambroveneto outsourcing accord with Debis.
newsitem.headline: Ambroveneto outsourcing accord with Debis.

text.p: Italian banking group Banco Ambrosiano Veneto said it would outsource all its data processing activity to Daimler-Benz unit Debis Systemhaus in a 10-year deal worth around one trillion lire.

The contract covers data processing, desk top management of some 10,000 terminals as well as management of the bank's 700 automated teller machines (ATM) and 17,000 electronic points of sale (POS), a statement said.
Under the agreement, Ambroveneto will sell to Debis the two group companies which up to now carried out these activities, with a combined annual turnover of 120 billion lire and 225 employees.
Ambroveneto said it stood to make around 350 billion lire over the contract period in savings and capital gains from the sale of the two companies.
